content.title: Know where to go
content.summary: Choose the safest room in your home before a warning ever comes.

sources.label: National Weather Service — Tornado Safety: During
National Weather Service — Understand Tornado Alerts

skill.cue: A tornado warning for your area: a tornado has been sighted or indicated by radar.
skill.action: Go to an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building, away from windows.
skill.why: Ready.gov says to stay away from windows, doors, and outside walls, and to watch out for flying debris.
checkInPrompts: A tornado warning comes in while you're home. Where does everyone go?
